scheme_name: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Poultry Development
other_conditions: Should be engaged in poultry farming or cattle development
Should be interested in availing loan for poultry farming or cattle development
Should intend to use the loan specifically for poultry farming or cattle development
benefits_summary: Provides loans up to ₹14,800 for 200 poultry birds or ₹17,000 for 2 cows at interest rates of 14.5%–16.5%.
